name: H2O: Há 2 Opções
source:
When a Mage who has powers over water, transported from a different era, comes into our modern world, he meets a real challenge in the form of a water rationing system from a modern city!

[From [url=https://lanford.itch.io/h2o]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一位拥有水之能力的法师从不同的时代来到我们的现代世界时，他遇到了来自现代城市的配水系统的真正挑战！

[来自[url=https://lanford.itch.io/h2o]itch.io[/url]]
